about.title: About Drape
about.lead: Drape is an independent edit of cyber Y2K streetwear: chrome, mesh, platforms and everything that glows.

sections.p: We search AliExpress, SHEIN and Bulchic for pieces that fit the look, then collect them here with honest notes. We don't make clothes and we don't hold stock.
When you choose a piece, we send you to the retailer that sells it. You check out on their site, and they handle payment, shipping, sizing and returns.
Some links earn us a small commission when you buy. It never adds to your price, and it never decides what we feature.
Drape is written in English, Mandarin, Hindi, Spanish, French, Arabic and Bengali. Pick yours from the language menu at the top of any page.

disclosure.title: Affiliate disclosure
disclosure.lead: Drape earns money through affiliate links. Here is exactly how that works.

sections.p: Every "Shop" button on Drape is an affiliate link. If you click one and buy something, the retailer may pay us a commission.
The commission comes from the retailer's marketing budget. You pay the same price you would pay going to the store directly.
Retailers cannot pay to appear on Drape. We choose pieces for how they look and how they're made, then look for an affiliate link afterwards.
Prices shown here are a guide, recorded when we added the piece. The retailer's site always has the final price, sizes and availability.
Outbound shop links are tagged {code} so search engines know they are paid links.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Drape collects as little as possible. This page explains what that means.

sections.p: We save your language choice in your browser's local storage so the site opens in the same language next time. It stays on your device and we never receive it.
You can't create an account or pay on Drape, so we never collect your name, address or card details.
When you follow a shop link, the retailer and its affiliate network may set their own cookies to track the sale. Their privacy policies apply on their sites.
Typefaces load from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address to deliver the files.
Questions about privacy? Write to {email} and we'll reply within 30 days.
